# MVS Analyzer 1.5.0 - development release notes

MVS 1.5.0 is the first CLI/Python-first release line. The Windows desktop is frozen at 1.4.0 and is no longer built or packaged.

The maintained release artifacts are the headless Linux CLI, the Python package, and source archive. Scientific changes for 1.5.0 are tracked in `docs/V1_5_PLAN.md`; benchmark results are preserved in `docs/BENCHMARK_HISTORY.md` with raw run artifacts under `benchmark_history/`.

Final 1.5.0 release notes will be written after the statistical method is frozen and its validation benchmark is complete.
